text:
Evening shift leads,
Before opening, the kennel attendant flagged some notes on pet arrivals
Hello team,

Please review the intake board with care and confirm that each animal has a clear kennel assignment, fresh water, and a calm transfer path. If a traveler has supplied comfort notes, place them with the file and make sure the welfare coordinator has already checked the animal comfort needs before handoff. Keep carrier labels visible, check that doors latch cleanly, and report any sign of stress, pacing, or refusal to settle right away.

When an issue comes up, follow the usual stepwise review and keep the conversation steady and factual. Start with the kennel setup, then check the travel documents, and then confirm whether the animal needs a quieter space or a slower transfer. If a pet arrives with a companion or family note, keep the record consistent and avoid making assumptions. Chester and any similar case should remain under close observation until the animal is comfortable and the paperwork matches the intake record.

Please also remind the desk team to speak in a low voice near the holding area, limit unnecessary movement, and pass updates directly to the senior coordinator. This keeps the workflow calm and helps Aurelia Skyways maintain safe service at the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Thank you for treating each arrival with patience and steady attention.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
